name: Visa Inc.
summary: Visa Inc. operates as a payments technology company in the United States and internationally. It operates VisaNet, a transaction processing network that enables authorization, clearing, and settlement of payment transactions. The company also offers credit, debit, and prepaid card products; tap to pay, tokenization, and click to pay services; Visa Direct, a platform which facilitates money movement, enabling clients to collect, hold, convert, and send funds across its network; and issuing solutions, such as airport lounge access, dining reservations, shopping experiences, event tickets, and seller offers.
